title: Pointers and linked-lists lab with AI and hybrid feedback
summary: CS1 students complete two C programming questions on pointers and linked lists during a three-hour graded lab. Depending on condition, they receive direct or Socratic GPT-4 feedback, manual TA help, or AI suggestions reviewed by a TA after failed tests.
